entities.name: Stéphanos II Ghattas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stéphanos II Ghattas was an Egyptian Catholic prelate who served as the Coptic Catholic Patriarch of Alexandria from 1986 to 2006. He was a member of the Congregation of the Mission and was made a cardinal in 2001. His cause for canonization was initiated after his death.
